info.name: Chili Piper — Conversation Inspector Actions Chat API

params.name: start
params.description: time of start such as 2025-01-08T13:46:18.681Z (ISO8601 format)

params.name: end
params.description: time of end such as 2025-01-14T13:46:18.681Z (ISO8601 format)

params.name: playbookId
params.description: Optional chat playbook id(s) to restrict the logs to; repeatable. When omitted, all playbooks in the workspace are considered.

params.name: guestEmail
params.description: Optional guest email to filter logs by (case-insensitive exact match). When omitted, all guests are considered.

params.name: guestId
params.description: Optional guest id to filter logs by (exact match). When omitted, all guests are considered.

params.name: ruleId
params.description: Optional routing-rule id to filter logs by (exact match on any rule executed in the session). Stable across rule renames. When omitted, all rules are considered.

params.name: ruleName
params.description: Optional routing-rule name to filter logs by (exact match on any rule executed in the session). When omitted, all rules are considered.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. First page has index 0.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items per page. Maximum is 50

items.docs:
[operation: chat-logs]



READ-ONLY



Reads a workspace's Chat AI conversation logs over a time window — the read-only audit trail of who chatted, how they were routed, and what got booked. Each entry carries the full bot/guest transcript, the routing outcome, and any meetings booked. Use it to inspect or debug live chat routing after the fact.
